title: skills: `objectstack-platform` teaches `engines: { protocol: '^17' }`, which the 18.x boot handshake refuses; scaffold and examples already write `'^18'`
body:
Filing gate **②**: a defect a seat read on `main`. Found by the contract review of PR #25667 (card #25666); filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (seat post #19287). Grade suggested S, p2 (a copied config fails boot); triage may regrade.

## Business rationale

- **Who benefits:** anyone who writes a stack config from the published `objectstack-platform` skill. The skill ships to customer projects inside `@objectstack/skills`.
- **Cost of not doing it:** `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L142 gives `engines: { protocol: '^17' }, // Metadata-protocol major this app targets`. On `main`, `PROTOCOL_VERSION = '18.0.0'` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts` L22), and the boot handshake refuses a range that excludes the runtime major (`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` ~L548, `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE`, 422). An app that copies the skill fails to boot on 18.x.

## Measured on `main`

- The scaffold and every example already write `'^18'`: `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts` L39, `examples/app-crm` L47, `app-todo` L48, `app-showcase` L88, `app-multi-package` (two packages).
- Stale in `skills/**`: `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L142; `objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` L7 (the expected output names `'^17'`); `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` L89 「every scaffold and example writes the caret form (`engines: { protocol: '^17' }`)」, which is now false as stated (L91's `'^17'` → `--from 17` is a worked example and can stay).
- No gate catches it: `check:skill-compatibility` reads only the frontmatter.

## Wanted

`'^17'` → `'^18'` at the three stale sites. Byte-neutral for the published-skills token ratchet.

## Reader (who acts)

The `domain:skills` seat, in-seat. `skills/**` is Tier H.

## Acceptance

- `git grep -n "protocol: '\^17'" skills/` finds only worked upgrade examples.
- `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` green; `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset.
- Writes: PR only through the relay's `pr_create`; ⛔ GitHub MCP writes.

## Dedupe

No open card for `engines.protocol` in `skills/**` (searched "skills engines protocol ^17 ^18"). #25666 left this out of its scope on purpose (a different value). **New.**
